About the Company

Dun & Bradstreet, a leading global provider of business decisioning data and analytics, enables companies around the world to improve their business performance. Dun & Bradstreet’s Data Cloud fuels solutions and delivers insights that empower customers to accelerate revenue, lower cost, mitigate risk and transform their businesses. Since 1841, companies of every size have relied on Dun & Bradstreet to help them manage risk and reveal opportunity. For more information on Dun & Bradstreet, please visit www.dnb.com. Dun & Bradstreet Information Services India Private Limited is headquartered in Mumbai and provides clients with data-driven products and technology-driven platforms to help them take faster and more accurate decisions across finance, risk, compliance, information technology and marketing. Working towards Government of India’s vision of creating an Atmanirbhar Bharat (Self-Reliant India) by supporting the Make in India initiative, Dun & Bradstreet India has a special focus on helping entrepreneurs enhance their visibility, increase their credibility, expand access to global markets, and identify potential customers & suppliers, while managing risk and opportunity.

Name: Mr. Prower Julian

Title: Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer

Personal Details/Achievements:
1985 Julian Prower is the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Dun & Bradstreet India, Taiwan and Executive Vice President, Global Business Operations & Transformation. In India, he leads the company’s strategic direction, business growth, and market execution, working closely with the leadership team to strengthen operational performance, deepen customer and partner engagement, and drive sustainable, profitable growth aligned with local market needs. His leadership reflects a strong commitment to building a resilient, future-ready organization that supports Indian enterprises with trusted data, insights, and decisioning solutions.


Name: Ms. Misra Preeta

Title: Vice President

Personal Details/Achievements:
2005 Preeta Misra is the Vice President, Commercial Business – India, Dun & Bradstreet. In this role, she is responsible for growing Dun & Bradstreet’s business across sectors and serving clients through tech-based solutions in the domains of sales, marketing, finance, risk, and compliance. She is also the chairperson of the Anti-Sexual Harassment Committee and leads diversity for Dun & Bradstreet India. Preeta has a rich experience of more than 27 years, including 20 years with Dun & Bradstreet. Prior to joining Dun & Bradstreet, Preeta was the MD & CEO of Business Asia Consulting Pvt. Ltd for five and a half years. Prior to that, she was the CEO of Invest India Economic Foundation for almost three years. She has also worked as a Financial Analyst with Express Investment Week, a weekly magazine published by the Indian Express Newspapers Group in Mumbai.


Name: Ms. Dhawan Pallavi

Title: Senior Director

Personal Details/Achievements:
2011 Pallavi leads Human Resources for Dun & Bradstreet entities in India. With a career spanning over 25 years, she is extremely passionate about helping individuals of all backgrounds find paths toward meaningful careers and partnering with the business to drive people centric processes and results. Throughout her own career, she has created innovative experiences, to help people make stronger career connections. She has also been a change leader across the enterprise, playing an active role in multiple major transformational initiatives. She has been instrumental in creating a diverse & inclusive culture where the best want to work and grow.


Name: Mr. Shah Saurabh

Title: Senior Director

Personal Details/Achievements:
2011 Saurabh Shah leads the Finance and Facilities team in India in the role of Senior Director - Finance. Saurabh specializes in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, treasury and risk management and India and US GAAP accounting, having previously served as finance controller of the businesses in India, UK and US for D&B.


Name: Mr. Joshi Govind

Title: Chief Operating Officer

Personal Details/Achievements:
2025 Govind Joshi is the Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, responsible for steering the organization through its next phase of business transformation, with a focus on ensuring operating scalability, fostering innovation, and optimizing processes to position the organization better for current and future market demands.
